BlackGapless.hint: Whether there shouldn't be gaps between child blocks on this document's sheet.
BlackGapless.label: Child Block Gapless

BlockSize.hint: Size that child blocks will be displayed at on this document's sheet.
BlockSize.label: Child Block Size

applyIfSuppressed.false: Don't Apply if Effect is Suppressed
applyIfSuppressed.label: Apply if Suppressed
applyIfSuppressed.true: Apply Even if Effect is Suppressed

EffectIdentifiers.hint: Identifiers of effects that are applied to Tokens within the Region. These are added in addition to the UUIDs above.
EffectIdentifiers.label: Effect Identifiers

attributes.hint: Attributes that will be changed as part of this morph.
attributes.label: Attributes

enabled.hint: Whether this effect causes a morph. This isn't just for transformation effects but for any case in which another species' stats should be applied (such as animating as an undead).
enabled.label: Causes Morph

img.hint: An image for morphed token art. Effect morph images are prioritized over species. This only applies if token art is overridden.
img.label: Token Image

override.hint: Aspects of the actor and its token that should be overridden by this morph.
override.label: Overrides

primary.hint: The species that provides this morph's token art and size override.
primary.label: Primary Species

resets.hint: Stats that should be reset by this morph.
resets.label: Stats

ring.hint: Whether this morph has a token ring or not. Effect morph rings are prioritized over species. This only applies if token art is overridden.
ring.label: Token Ring

ringImg.hint: A different image to use for morphed token art if ring is enabled.
ringImg.label: Token Ring Image

suppress.hint: Types of documents this should turn off if they're not provided by the morph.
suppress.label: Suppressed Types

TerrainMode.hint: Whether these terrain types are added to, subtracted from, or override less specific terrain types.
TerrainMode.label: Terrain Mode
